name: Entrancing Filigree's On Enter banish of an opponent's object
notes: Entrancing Filigree is a TERA (advanced element) REGALIA,ITEM card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real TERA champion (Kongming, Fel Eidolon) to unlock element access. Its memory cost (2) is NOT exercised here: materializing via a direct mode 10002 FSM click on the hand card resolves straight through DoMaterialize() without ever routing through the MATERIALIZE decision's card-specific additional-cost switch in MaterializeLogic.php (verified live -- myMemory contents are unchanged after materializing), so this fixture covers only the targeting/zone-movement/On-Enter half, not the memory-cost payment mechanic. Dungeon Guide is seeded onto the opponent's field as the On Enter banish target, and lands in the opponent's OWN banish zone (not a shared/neutral zone). The On Leave 'return it rested' trigger requires removing this card from the field afterward and is out of scope.

rulesClauses: On Enter: As a Spell, banish target non-champion object you don't control.
